caption: The drawing features several white outlined shapes on a dark, speckled background. In the left portion, there are multiple animal-like figures resembling quadrupeds scattered throughout, some grouped near a large, concentric circle at the bottom left, which is divided by crosshatching lines. In the center, there is a tall, human-like stick figure composed of a rectangular body with four horizontal segments, outstretched arms, and a round head with facial features. Connected to this figure is a line leading to another animal shape and a large rounded shape. To the right of the stick figure is a large round face outlined in white with simple facial details, including a line for a mouth that contains vertical stripes, and two dots for eyes. To the far right, the composition is divided by a diagonal line: the upper right section contains several handprint-like and footprint-like shapes of various sizes scattered randomly, while the lower right contains a cluster of vertical lines, some more animal-like figures, and some irregular shapes that may represent vegetation or additional creatures. The overall color palette is monochromatic with only black and white used throughout the image.
title: Petroglyph
